INSERT INTO transactions (user_id, category_id, type, amount, note, transaction_date, raw_input)
SELECT u.id, c.id, '{{ $json.type }}', {{ $json.amount }}, '{{$json.note}}', '{{ $json.date }}', '{{ $('Telegram Trigger').item.json.message.text }}'
FROM users u
LEFT JOIN categories c ON LOWER(c.name) = LOWER('{{ $json.category }}')
  AND (c.user_id = u.id OR c.user_id IS NULL)
WHERE u.chat_id = {{ $json.chatId }}
RETURNING id;

SELECT 
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN type='income' THEN amount END), 0) AS total_income,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN type='expense' THEN amount END), 0) AS total_expense,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN type='income' THEN amount END), 0) - 
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN type='expense' THEN amount END), 0) AS balance
FROM transactions
WHERE user_id = (SELECT id FROM users WHERE chat_id = {{ $json.message.chat.id }})
  AND transaction_date >= DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE);

parameters.query:
SELECT t.id, t.type, t.amount, t.note, t.transaction_date,
       COALESCE(c.name, 'other') AS category
FROM transactions t
LEFT JOIN categories c ON c.id = t.category_id
WHERE t.user_id = (SELECT id FROM users WHERE chat_id = {{ $('Parse History Filter').first().json.chatId }})
ORDER BY t.transaction_date DESC, t.created_at DESC
LIMIT 50;

SELECT c.name AS category, 
       SUM(t.amount) AS total,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(t.amount) / SUM(SUM(t.amount)) OVER(), 1) AS pct
FROM transactions t
LEFT JOIN categories c ON c.id = t.category_id
WHERE t.user_id = (SELECT id FROM users WHERE chat_id = {{ $json.message.chat.id }})
  AND t.type = 'expense'
  AND t.transaction_date >= DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE)
GROUP BY c.name
ORDER BY total DESC;

INSERT INTO budgets (user_id, category_id, period, limit_amount, alert_at_pct)
SELECT 
  u.id,
  c.id,
  'monthly',
  {{ $('Code in JavaScript3').item.json.amount }},
  80
FROM users u, categories c
WHERE u.chat_id = {{ $('Code in JavaScript3').item.json.chatId }}
  AND LOWER(c.name) = LOWER('{{ $('Code in JavaScript3').item.json.category }}')
ON CONFLICT (user_id, category_id, period) DO UPDATE 
  SET limit_amount = EXCLUDED.limit_amount
RETURNING id;

SELECT b.limit_amount, b.period,
       COALESCE(c.name, 'all categories') AS category,
       COALESCE(c.emoji, '💰') AS emoji
FROM budgets b
LEFT JOIN categories c ON c.id = b.category_id
WHERE b.user_id = (SELECT id FROM users WHERE chat_id = {{ $json.message.chat.id }})
  AND b.is_active = TRUE
ORDER BY b.created_at DESC;

DELETE FROM transactions
WHERE id = (
  SELECT id FROM transactions
  WHERE user_id = (SELECT id FROM users WHERE chat_id = {{ $json.message.chat.id }})
  ORDER BY created_at DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
RETURNING amount, note, type, transaction_date;
